# fw ask

> Reference of the fw ask command: Run the multi-turn coding agent with tool calls (--model --url --resume --full-access --json). Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/ask/

Run the multi-turn coding agent with tool calls (--model --url --resume --full-access --json)

## Usage

```bash
fw ask [flags] <prompt>
```

## Aliases

`fw chat` runs `fw ask`.

## Flags

The help text names these flags: `--model`, `--url`, `--resume`, `--full-access`, `--json`.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
